That repair and synthetic tokenization make the historical promotion a confirmed false positive for a runtime guarantee, even though they do not prove that all future constrained decoders fail.

The allowed rejection is limited to CTRL-01 runtime qualification and the historical promotion on this frozen JSON construct.
